cleanup.realMacGate: Pipe-gated actual child: WNOWAIT exit-pending and same-birth BSD zombie; raw PID signal-zero succeeds and group signal-zero is EPERM; exact reap then fresh group ESRCH. No signals sent.

ordinaryNativeCensus.failClosed: Zero/error/short/saturated/truncated/conflicting evidence remains unavailable. EINVAL is not gone. A read failure is skipped only after fresh authoritative absence/zombie evidence.
